blocks.zh: 結論、參考文獻與案例研究 — 溫控藥品配送資格認證實務精華
blocks.en: Conclusion, References and Case Studies: Practical Essentials of Distribution Qualification for Temperature-Controlled Medicinal Products

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 TR39 的核心目的：為溫控藥品 (temperature-sensitive medicinal products) 的配送資格認證 (distribution qualification) 建立系統化流程。
blocks.en: Understand the core purpose of TR39: to establish a systematic process for the distribution qualification of temperature-sensitive medicinal products.

blocks.zh: 能夠套用 案例研究 1 的偏差趨勢分析架構，識別高風險配送航線並觸發 CAPA (糾正與預防措施)。
blocks.en: Be able to apply the deviation trend analysis framework of Case Study 1 to identify high-risk distribution lanes and trigger CAPA (corrective and preventive action).

blocks.zh: 掌握 案例研究 2 中被動保溫箱 (passive shipper) SOP 的關鍵要素：組裝圖、人員訓練、凝膠包 (gel pack) 與相變材料 (phase-change materials, PCM) 的調溫程序。
blocks.en: Master the key elements of the passive shipper SOP in Case Study 2: assembly diagram, personnel training, and the conditioning procedure for gel packs and phase-change materials (PCM).

blocks.zh: 了解 案例研究 3 的資格認證總計畫 (Qualification Master Plan, QMP) 架構，包含設計確認 (DQ)、操作確認 (OQ)、效能確認 (PQ) 三階段的邏輯連結。
blocks.en: Understand the Qualification Master Plan (QMP) structure of Case Study 3, including the logical links between the three stages of design qualification (DQ), operational qualification (OQ) and performance qualification (PQ).

blocks.zh: 識別 TR39 引用的關鍵外部標準 (ICH Q9、ISTA、ISO、WHO 等)，並理解這些標準對 CDMO 冷鏈作業的監管意義。
blocks.en: Identify the key external standards cited in TR39 (ICH Q9, ISTA, ISO, WHO, etc.) and understand their regulatory significance for CDMO cold chain operations.

blocks.zh: 6.0 Conclusion — 結論
blocks.en: 6.0 Conclusion

blocks.zh: 解讀與應用
blocks.en: Interpretation and Application

blocks.zh: 「What vs. How」的核心邏輯：TR39 刻意只定義「必須做什麼」，而將「如何做」留給各組織根據當地法規與產品特性自行決定。這是 PDA 技術報告的標準定位——提供框架，不強制規定細節。
blocks.en: The core logic of "What vs. How": TR39 deliberately defines only what must be done, and leaves how to do it to each organization to decide according to local regulations and product characteristics. This is the standard positioning of a PDA technical report: it provides a framework and does not prescribe details.

blocks.zh: TR39 覆蓋的完整生命週期
blocks.en: The full lifecycle covered by TR39

blocks.zh: 製程設計 (Process Design)：選擇合適的熱保護系統
blocks.en: Process Design: selecting a suitable thermal protection system

blocks.zh: 實施與操作 (Implementation & Operation)：裝箱、運輸執行
blocks.en: Implementation & Operation: packing and shipment execution

blocks.zh: 驗證 (Verification)：OQ / PQ 確認系統有效
blocks.en: Verification: OQ / PQ confirm that the system is effective

blocks.zh: 終點 (End point)：確保藥品抵達患者時仍符合品質要求
blocks.en: End point: ensuring that the product still meets quality requirements when it reaches the patient

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的意義
blocks.en: What this means for a CDMO

blocks.zh: TWi 提供委託製造服務，冷鏈配送是服務交付的最後一哩路。TR39 的結論提醒我們：資格認證文件不只是內部合規要求，更是對客戶承諾「藥品品質在整個供應鏈中受到保護」的書面證明。
blocks.en: TWi provides contract manufacturing services, and cold chain distribution is the last mile of service delivery. The conclusion of TR39 is a reminder that qualification documents are not just an internal compliance requirement; they are also written proof to the customer that "product quality is protected throughout the supply chain."

blocks.zh: 7.0 References — 參考文獻
blocks.en: 7.0 References

blocks.zh: 關鍵文獻解讀
blocks.en: Key References Explained

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 — 品質風險管理 (最重要基礎)
blocks.en: ICH Q9 - Quality Risk Management (the most important foundation)

blocks.zh: TR39 的整個資格認證框架建立在 ICH Q9 的風險管理原則上。「先做風險分析，再設計測試計畫」的邏輯源自此。在 CDMO 環境中，每條新航線都應先進行 Route Risk Assessment (航線風險評估)，再決定 TPS 規格。
blocks.en: The entire qualification framework of TR39 is built on the risk management principles of ICH Q9. The logic of "do the risk analysis first, then design the test plan" comes from here. In a CDMO environment, every new lane should first undergo a Route Risk Assessment before the TPS specification is decided.

blocks.zh: PDA TR58 — 溫控配送風險管理
blocks.en: PDA TR58 - Risk Management for Temperature-Controlled Distribution

blocks.zh: TR58 是 TR39 的姊妹文件，專注於風險管理方法論。若客戶要求「說明你的冷鏈風險管理依據」，可同時引用 TR39（資格認證框架）+ TR58（風險管理方法）。
blocks.en: TR58 is the sister document of TR39 and focuses on risk management methodology. If a customer asks you to "explain the basis of your cold chain risk management," you can cite TR39 (qualification framework) and TR58 (risk management method) together.

blocks.zh: ISTA 測試標準的角色
blocks.en: The role of ISTA test standards

blocks.zh: ISTA 7D / 7E / Standard 20 定義了「如何對包裝系統進行溫度測試」的標準方法。就像 ICH Q2 定義分析方法驗證標準一樣——TR39 告訴你「需要做測試」，ISTA 告訴你「用什麼方法測」。
blocks.en: ISTA 7D / 7E / Standard 20 define the standard methods for "how to temperature-test a packaging system." It is like ICH Q2 defining the standard for analytical method validation: TR39 tells you that testing is needed, and ISTA tells you which method to test with.

blocks.zh: Van Asselt et al. 七步驟模型
blocks.en: The Van Asselt et al. seven-step model

blocks.zh: Reference 8（Van Asselt & Bishara 2020, PMPS）提出的「7步驟藥品出貨系統資格認證模型」是 TR39 的核心實務架構來源，值得深入閱讀。
blocks.en: The "7-step qualification model for pharmaceutical shipping systems" proposed in Reference 8 (Van Asselt & Bishara 2020, PMPS) is the source of TR39's core practical framework and is worth reading in depth.

blocks.zh: 8.0 Case Studies — 案例研究
blocks.en: 8.0 Case Studies

blocks.zh: 案例研究的定位
blocks.en: Positioning of the case studies

blocks.zh: PDA 明確指出這些案例是「方法範例」，不是唯一正確做法。這給予 CDMO 彈性空間：可以採用不同的具體工具與格式，只要核心邏輯（風險分析 → 設計 → 確認 → 驗證）一致即可。
blocks.en: PDA states explicitly that these cases are "examples of methods," not the only correct approach. This gives a CDMO flexibility: different specific tools and formats can be adopted, as long as the core logic (risk analysis → design → qualification → verification) stays consistent.

blocks.zh: 三個案例的互補關係
blocks.en: How the three cases complement each other

blocks.zh: 案例 1：偏差趨勢分析（回顧歷史數據，持續改進）
blocks.en: Case 1: deviation trend analysis (reviewing historical data for continual improvement)

blocks.zh: 案例 2：SOP 撰寫（標準化日常操作，防止人為失誤）
blocks.en: Case 2: SOP writing (standardizing routine operations to prevent human error)

blocks.zh: 案例 3：資格認證總計畫（規劃前瞻性的系統確認架構）
blocks.en: Case 3: Qualification Master Plan (planning a forward-looking system qualification framework)

blocks.zh: 8.1 Case Study 1: Distribution Incident Trends Analysis — 配送事件趨勢分析
blocks.en: 8.1 Case Study 1: Distribution Incident Trends Analysis

blocks.zh: 案例 1 深度解析：趨勢分析框架
blocks.en: Case 1 in depth: the trend analysis framework

blocks.zh: 三層偏差分類邏輯
blocks.en: Three-tier deviation classification logic

blocks.zh: Major/Critical 嚴重偏差：有產品品質影響 → 強制開 CAPA
blocks.en: Major/Critical deviations: impact on product quality → CAPA is mandatory

blocks.zh: Minor 輕微偏差：無產品品質影響 → 不強制 CAPA，但需納入趨勢分析
blocks.en: Minor deviations: no impact on product quality → CAPA not mandatory, but they must be included in the trend analysis

blocks.zh: 趨勢觸發：同一目的地/根本原因 12 個月內出現 >2 次 → 升級為 CAPA
blocks.en: Trend trigger: more than 2 occurrences for the same destination/root cause within 12 months → escalate to CAPA

blocks.zh: 這套「分層 + 趨勢觸發」機制避免了為每個小事件開 CAPA 的資源浪費，同時不放過系統性問題。
blocks.en: This "tiering + trend trigger" mechanism avoids the waste of resources of opening a CAPA for every minor event, while still not missing systemic problems.

blocks.zh: 比喻：如何理解 Percentile 95 規則
blocks.en: Analogy: understanding the Percentile 95 rule

blocks.zh: 想像你有 100 條配送航線。Percentile 95 代表你只聚焦偏差率最高的 5 條（最壞的 5%）。這是一種 Pareto 原則（80/20 法則）的應用——集中資源在最高風險的少數航線上，而非平均分散注意力。
blocks.en: Imagine you have 100 distribution lanes. Percentile 95 means you focus only on the 5 lanes with the highest deviation rates (the worst 5%). This is an application of the Pareto principle (80/20 rule): concentrate resources on the few highest-risk lanes rather than spreading attention evenly.

blocks.zh: 根本原因分類的重要性
blocks.en: The importance of root cause classification

blocks.zh: TR39 要求同時記錄「根本原因擁有者 (root cause owner)」與「根本原因地點 (root cause location)」。這兩個維度讓你能回答：
blocks.en: TR39 requires recording both the "root cause owner" and the "root cause location." These two dimensions let you answer:

blocks.zh: 是誰造成的？（航空公司、貨運代理、卡車司機、冷鏈供應商）
blocks.en: Who caused it? (airline, freight forwarder, truck driver, cold chain supplier)

blocks.zh: 在哪裡發生的？（停機坪等待時間、轉運機場、高速公路休息站）
blocks.en: Where did it happen? (tarmac waiting time, transit airport, highway rest stop)

blocks.zh: 沒有這兩個維度，CAPA 就無法指向正確的改善對象。
blocks.en: Without these two dimensions, a CAPA cannot point to the right target for improvement.

blocks.zh: TWi CDMO 應用：年度冷鏈 KPI 報告
blocks.en: TWi CDMO application: annual cold chain KPI report

blocks.zh: 建立每季一次的配送偏差統計表（按客戶、航線、貨運類型分類）
blocks.en: Build a quarterly distribution deviation statistics table (classified by customer, lane and shipment type)

blocks.zh: 使用 12 個月滾動數據計算各目的地偏差率，識別高風險航線
blocks.en: Use 12-month rolling data to calculate the deviation rate for each destination and identify high-risk lanes

blocks.zh: 將趨勢分析結果納入客戶年度品質報告（Annual Product Quality Review, APQR），展示主動管理能力
blocks.en: Include the trend analysis results in the customer's Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) to demonstrate proactive management capability

blocks.zh: 對 >2 次同類事件的航線，主動提出航線 re-qualification 建議，而非等待客戶詢問
blocks.en: For lanes with more than 2 events of the same type, proactively propose lane re-qualification instead of waiting for the customer to ask

blocks.zh: 8.2 Case Study 2: Passive Shipper SOPs — 被動保溫箱標準作業程序
blocks.en: 8.2 Case Study 2: Passive Shipper SOPs

blocks.zh: When using passive shippers (被動保溫箱), the assembly diagram, photos, and a description should be included within either the SOP or protocol. As with a puzzle, the multiple pieces must be assembled correctly. A written description of the process to assemble a passive shipper must accompany the diagram. Training should be completed and documented for all employees who will assemble passive shippers. Retraining schedules should be developed and maintained. Audits need to be performed on the accuracy of the passive shipper assembly. Random checks may be done after a passive shipper has been assembled and finalized. The Quality Unit should randomly select shippers and open them to verify proper assembly.
blocks.en: When using passive shippers, the assembly diagram, photos, and a description should be included within either the SOP or protocol. As with a puzzle, the multiple pieces must be assembled correctly. A written description of the process to assemble a passive shipper must accompany the diagram. Training should be completed and documented for all employees who will assemble passive shippers. Retraining schedules should be developed and maintained. Audits need to be performed on the accuracy of the passive shipper assembly. Random checks may be done after a passive shipper has been assembled and finalized. The Quality Unit should randomly select shippers and open them to verify proper assembly.

blocks.zh: Gel packs (凝膠保冷袋) and phase-change materials (相變材料, PCM) are used inside passive shippers to maintain temperature. Frozen gel packs and phase-change materials can be at different temperatures, such as −15 °C to −10 °C. Knowing at what temperature these materials should be, according to the passive shipper requirements, is essential to understand. Consistency is needed to assure that equipment used to condition and store gel packs and phase-change materials are capable of producing gel packs and phase-change materials at the proper temperature. The next step is to determine how long gel packs and phase-change materials need to stay inside the equipment to ensure the proper temperature. In most cases, it may require many days to condition these products depending if they are stored on a pallet, in a box, or individually.
blocks.en: Gel packs and phase-change materials (PCM) are used inside passive shippers to maintain temperature. Frozen gel packs and phase-change materials can be at different temperatures, such as −15 °C to −10 °C. Knowing at what temperature these materials should be, according to the passive shipper requirements, is essential to understand. Consistency is needed to assure that equipment used to condition and store gel packs and phase-change materials are capable of producing gel packs and phase-change materials at the proper temperature. The next step is to determine how long gel packs and phase-change materials need to stay inside the equipment to ensure the proper temperature. In most cases, it may require many days to condition these products depending if they are stored on a pallet, in a box, or individually.

blocks.zh: 案例 2 深度解析：SOP 關鍵要素
blocks.en: Case 2 in depth: key SOP elements

blocks.zh: 被動保溫箱 SOP 的六大核心要素
blocks.en: The six core elements of a passive shipper SOP

blocks.zh: 組裝圖與照片 (Assembly Diagram & Photos)：文字描述必須搭配視覺材料，像拼圖一樣每個零件都有正確位置。
blocks.en: Assembly Diagram & Photos: the written description must be accompanied by visual material; like a puzzle, every part has its correct position.

blocks.zh: 訓練記錄 (Training Documentation)：所有組裝人員需完成培訓並留下書面記錄；定期重訓計畫必須建立並維護。
blocks.en: Training Documentation: all assembly personnel must complete training and leave a written record; a periodic retraining program must be established and maintained.

blocks.zh: 隨機查核 (Random Audits)：品保單位須不定期開箱驗查組裝正確性，這是品質保證的最後一道防線。
blocks.en: Random Audits: the Quality Unit must open shippers at random to verify correct assembly; this is the last line of defense in quality assurance.

blocks.zh: 運輸模式定義 (Transport Mode Definition)：在執行任何 qualification 前，必須先明確定義運輸方式（空運/陸運/海運）。
blocks.en: Transport Mode Definition: before any qualification is carried out, the mode of transport (air / road / sea) must be clearly defined.

blocks.zh: 凝膠包/PCM 調溫程序 (Conditioning Procedure)：包含目標溫度、調溫時間、儲存方式（棧板/箱裝/單獨）。
blocks.en: Conditioning Procedure for gel packs/PCM: includes the target temperature, conditioning time and storage method (pallet / box / individual).

blocks.zh: 隔離材料 (Separation Material)：若 PCM 為冷凍狀態，SOP 必須包含防止直接接觸藥品的隔離層說明。
blocks.en: Separation Material: if the PCM is frozen, the SOP must describe the separation layer that prevents direct contact with the product.

blocks.zh: PCM 調溫時間的關鍵細節
blocks.en: Key details of PCM conditioning time

blocks.zh: TR39 特別強調：PCM 的調溫時間可能需要數天，且依儲存方式不同（棧板整批 vs. 箱裝 vs. 單個）而有顯著差異。這是許多機構常忽略的細節——在 SOP 中只寫「放入 2–8°C 冰箱」而未指定時間，等同於未完整記錄關鍵參數。
blocks.en: TR39 specifically stresses that PCM conditioning may take several days, and differs significantly depending on how it is stored (whole pallet vs. in a box vs. individually). This is a detail many organizations overlook: an SOP that only says "place in a 2-8°C refrigerator" without specifying the time is equivalent to not fully documenting a critical parameter.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Thermal Shock（熱衝擊）的風險
blocks.en: Analogy: the risk of thermal shock

blocks.zh: 想像你拿一個剛從 −20°C 取出的冷凍 PCM，直接放在玻璃瓶裝的生物製劑旁邊。PCM 表面溫度可能瞬間使接觸點溫度降到冰點以下，造成蛋白質變性——產品外觀可能看起來正常，但生物活性已不可逆損失。這就是「隔離材料」在 SOP 中不可省略的原因。
blocks.en: Imagine you take a frozen PCM straight out of −20°C and place it right next to a biologic in a glass vial. The PCM surface temperature can instantly drive the temperature at the contact point below freezing, causing protein denaturation. The product may look normal, but its biological activity has been irreversibly lost. This is why the "separation material" cannot be omitted from the SOP.

blocks.zh: 載體品質協議 (Carrier Quality Agreement)
blocks.en: Carrier Quality Agreement

blocks.zh: TR39 建議與物流服務提供商簽訂品質協議，明確規定：
blocks.en: TR39 recommends entering into a quality agreement with the logistics service provider that clearly specifies:

blocks.zh: 處理溫度敏感貨物的標準程序
blocks.en: Standard procedures for handling temperature-sensitive cargo

blocks.zh: 允許的最長過境等待時間
blocks.en: Maximum permitted transit waiting time

blocks.zh: 溫度監控設備的使用要求
blocks.en: Requirements for the use of temperature monitoring devices

blocks.zh: 異常事件的通報機制
blocks.en: Reporting mechanism for abnormal events

blocks.zh: 這份協議是 GDP 審核中的常見查驗項目。
blocks.en: This agreement is a commonly checked item in GDP audits.

blocks.zh: TWi CDMO 應用：通過 GDP 稽核的 SOP 設計
blocks.en: TWi CDMO application: SOP design that passes GDP audits

blocks.zh: SOP 結構：每種被動保溫箱型號建立獨立 SOP，包含 (1) 組裝步驟圖 (2) PCM 調溫矩陣表（型號 × 儲存方式 × 所需時間）(3) 放行查核表
blocks.en: SOP structure: create a separate SOP for each passive shipper model, including (1) assembly step diagram (2) PCM conditioning matrix (model × storage method × required time) (3) release checklist

blocks.zh: 訓練記錄：建立電子化訓練矩陣，可即時顯示哪些人員已完成認證，到期提醒自動觸發
blocks.en: Training records: build an electronic training matrix that shows in real time which personnel have completed certification, with automatic expiry reminders

blocks.zh: GDP 稽核亮點：隨機查核記錄（品保開箱驗查）是稽核員最喜歡查的文件，建議單獨建立查核 log，並定期統計查核通過率作為 KPI
blocks.en: GDP audit highlight: random check records (Quality Unit opening shippers for verification) are the documents auditors like to check most; it is recommended to keep a separate check log and to track the check pass rate periodically as a KPI

blocks.zh: 客戶交付：首次合作客戶可要求提供 PCM 調溫驗證報告，作為技術能力的佐證
blocks.en: Customer delivery: a first-time customer may ask for a PCM conditioning validation report as evidence of technical capability

blocks.zh: 8.3 Case Study 3: Qualification Master Plan — 資格認證總計畫
blocks.en: 8.3 Case Study 3: Qualification Master Plan

blocks.zh: To make validation terminology applicable to a good distribution practices (GDP) environment, a qualification master plan (QMP) (資格認證總計畫) is written to define the qualification strategy. For each qualification step — design, operational, and performance qualifications — a rationale is written to support the qualification program according to the type (active or passive) of thermal protection system (TPS).
blocks.en: To make validation terminology applicable to a good distribution practices (GDP) environment, a qualification master plan (QMP) is written to define the qualification strategy. For each qualification step — design, operational, and performance qualifications — a rationale is written to support the qualification program according to the type (active or passive) of thermal protection system (TPS).

blocks.zh: 案例 3 深度解析：QMP 架構
blocks.en: Case 3 in depth: QMP structure

blocks.zh: QMP 的三階段邏輯鏈
blocks.en: The three-stage logic chain of the QMP

blocks.zh:
DQ — 設計確認 (Design Qualification)
選擇合適 TPS 類型（主動/被動）
blocks.en:
DQ - Design Qualification
Select a suitable TPS type (active/passive)

blocks.zh:
OQ — 操作確認 (Operational Qualification)
靜態條件 / 熱腔室測試 / 冬夏兩季
blocks.en:
OQ - Operational Qualification
Static conditions / thermal chamber testing / winter and summer seasons

blocks.zh:
PQ — 效能確認 (Performance Qualification)
動態條件 / 真實出貨 / 多目的地矩陣
blocks.en:
PQ - Performance Qualification
Dynamic conditions / real shipments / multi-destination matrix

blocks.zh: 每個階段完成後出具報告，OQ → PQ 之間需有「中間資格認證摘要報告 (Intermediate Qualification Summary Report)」作為橋接。
blocks.en: A report is issued on completion of each stage, and between OQ and PQ an "Intermediate Qualification Summary Report" is needed as a bridge.

blocks.zh: 比喻：OQ 是「練習賽」，PQ 是「正式比賽」
blocks.en: Analogy: OQ is the "practice match" and PQ is the "real match"

blocks.zh: OQ 在受控熱腔室環境中確認系統設計有效；PQ 在真實航線上用連續出貨確認這個設計在現實條件下仍然成立。就像飛行員先在模擬機（OQ）訓練，再執行真實飛行任務（PQ）。中間的「Intermediate Report」就是模擬訓練的成績單，決定是否可以進入真實飛行。
blocks.en: OQ confirms in a controlled thermal chamber that the system design works; PQ uses consecutive shipments on real lanes to confirm that the design still holds under real-world conditions. It is like a pilot who first trains in a simulator (OQ) and then flies a real mission (PQ). The "Intermediate Report" in between is the simulator training report card, which decides whether you can move on to real flights.

blocks.zh: 季節與區域異常的考量
blocks.en: Seasonal and regional anomalies

blocks.zh: TR39 特別強調：PQ 測試必須在最具挑戰性的時間點進行——冬季測試要選最冷的時期，夏季測試要選最熱的時期。此外，區域異常天氣（如季風、極端寒流）也必須納入考量。這個原則確保 qualification 結果具有「代表性的最壞情境」涵蓋。
blocks.en: TR39 specifically stresses that PQ testing must be conducted at the most challenging times: winter testing should be done in the coldest period, and summer testing in the hottest. In addition, regional weather anomalies (such as monsoons and extreme cold snaps) must also be considered. This principle ensures that the qualification results cover a "representative worst case."

blocks.zh: 持續效能驗證計畫 (Continuous Performance Verification)
blocks.en: Continuous Performance Verification program

blocks.zh: TR39 提出一個進階選項：對所有出貨進行溫度監控，定期（季/年）統計不符合事件數量，以此替代週期性重新 qualification。這是一種 lifecycle approach（生命週期方法），與 PDA TR60 的工廠製程驗證哲學相同——用持續監控取代一次性驗證。
blocks.en: TR39 presents an advanced option: monitor the temperature of all shipments and periodically (quarterly/annually) count the number of non-conforming events, using this in place of periodic re-qualification. This is a lifecycle approach, the same philosophy as the plant process validation of PDA TR60: replacing one-time validation with continuous monitoring.

blocks.zh: TWi CDMO 應用：客戶交付的 QMP 範本
blocks.en: TWi CDMO application: QMP template for customer delivery

blocks.zh: QMP 文件結構：建立標準化 QMP 範本，章節包含：(1) TPS 選擇依據 (2) 航線矩陣（目的地 × 季節 × 產品類型）(3) OQ 計畫 (4) Intermediate Report 框架 (5) PQ 計畫 (6) 持續監控架構
blocks.en: QMP document structure: create a standardized QMP template with the following sections: (1) TPS selection rationale (2) lane matrix (destination × season × product type) (3) OQ plan (4) Intermediate Report framework (5) PQ plan (6) continuous monitoring framework

blocks.zh: 矩陣方法 (Matrix Approach)：若多個目的地 / 產品類型共用同一 TPS，使用矩陣法減少重複測試——合理分組，一次 qualification 涵蓋多個場景
blocks.en: Matrix approach: if multiple destinations / product types share the same TPS, use a matrix approach to reduce duplicate testing: group them sensibly so that one qualification covers multiple scenarios

blocks.zh: 客戶報告亮點：在客戶年度技術審查中，提供「冷鏈 qualification 狀態矩陣」（顯示哪些航線已完成 OQ/PQ，哪些在進行中，哪些需要重新 qualification）
blocks.en: Customer reporting highlight: in the customer's annual technical review, provide a "cold chain qualification status matrix" (showing which lanes have completed OQ/PQ, which are in progress, and which need re-qualification)

blocks.zh: 法規雙語備查：QMP 建議同時對應 FDA (21 CFR Part 211) 與 EU GDP Guidelines，確保跨區域客戶均可接受
blocks.en: Regulatory cross-reference: it is recommended that the QMP map to both the FDA (21 CFR Part 211) and the EU GDP Guidelines, so that customers in all regions can accept it

blocks.zh: 9.0 Additional Reading — 延伸閱讀
blocks.en: 9.0 Additional Reading

blocks.zh: 延伸閱讀的戰略價值
blocks.en: The strategic value of additional reading

blocks.zh: 必讀優先清單（CDMO 視角）
blocks.en: Priority must-read list (CDMO perspective)

blocks.zh: PDA TR72（被動 TPS）+ PDA TR64（主動 TPS）：TR39 的技術細節補充，針對你使用的系統類型必讀
blocks.en: PDA TR72 (passive TPS) + PDA TR64 (active TPS): technical detail supplements to TR39; must-read for the type of system you use

blocks.zh: EU GDP Guidelines：歐洲客戶的稽核基準，也是全球最嚴格的 GDP 規範之一
blocks.en: EU GDP Guidelines: the audit benchmark for European customers, and one of the strictest GDP standards in the world

blocks.zh: USP <1079>：美國客戶最常引用的成品藥儲運風險指引，直接影響 product specification
blocks.en: USP <1079>: the guidance on risk of storage and transportation of finished drug products most often cited by US customers, with a direct impact on the product specification

blocks.zh: ISTA PCG-02：被動包裝系統 OQ 的詳細操作指南，是 Case Study 3 的技術細節延伸
blocks.en: ISTA PCG-02: detailed operating guidance for OQ of passive packaging systems, and a technical extension of Case Study 3

blocks.zh: Van Asselt 2020（七步驟模型）：TR39 實務操作最完整的白皮書，建議逐段對照 TR39 閱讀
blocks.en: Van Asselt 2020 (seven-step model): the most complete white paper on practical implementation of TR39; it is recommended to read it section by section alongside TR39

blocks.zh: 如何使用這份延伸閱讀清單
blocks.en: How to use this additional reading list

blocks.zh: 把 TR39 視為「冷鏈資格認證的地圖」，延伸閱讀清單是各個目的地的「詳細旅遊指南」。TR39 告訴你需要到哪裡（DQ/OQ/PQ），而 ISTA、USP、WHO 等文件告訴你抵達那裡後的具體操作步驟。
blocks.en: Think of TR39 as the "map of cold chain qualification" and the additional reading list as the "detailed travel guides" for each destination. TR39 tells you where you need to go (DQ/OQ/PQ), while documents such as ISTA, USP and WHO tell you the specific steps once you get there.

blocks.zh: TWi 知識庫建設建議
blocks.en: Recommendations for building the TWi knowledge base

blocks.zh: 建立冷鏈標準文件矩陣：橫軸為標準文件（TR39、TR72、EU GDP 等），縱軸為業務活動（航線 qualification、SOP 撰寫、稽核回應），標示每個交叉點的相關性
blocks.en: Build a cold chain standards matrix: standard documents on the horizontal axis (TR39, TR72, EU GDP, etc.), business activities on the vertical axis (lane qualification, SOP writing, audit response), and mark the relevance at each intersection

blocks.zh: EU GDP 與 USP <1079> 是最高頻率的客戶稽核查驗項目，建議優先完成內部差距分析
blocks.en: EU GDP and USP <1079> are the most frequently checked items in customer audits; it is recommended to complete an internal gap analysis for them first

blocks.zh: 將 Van Asselt 七步驟白皮書納入新進冷鏈人員訓練材料，作為 TR39 的閱讀前導
blocks.en: Include the Van Asselt seven-step white paper in the training materials for new cold chain staff, as preparatory reading before TR39

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 本節精華總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: TR39 結論的核心訊息：報告提供「什麼 (what)」的框架，不規定「如何做 (how)」，給組織根據法規與業務需求的彈性空間。目標是確保藥品品質在整個供應鏈中受到保護，直到抵達患者。
blocks.en: Core message of the TR39 conclusion: the report provides a framework for the "what" and does not prescribe the "how," leaving organizations flexibility according to regulations and business needs. The goal is to ensure that product quality is protected throughout the supply chain until it reaches the patient.

blocks.zh: 案例 1 — 偏差趨勢分析：採用分層管理（Major → 強制 CAPA；Minor → 趨勢追蹤）+ 12 個月滾動窗口 + Percentile 95 觸發機制。同一目的地/根本原因 >2 次 → 觸發 CAPA。CDMO 應用：納入客戶年度品質報告 (APQR) 的冷鏈 KPI 分析。
blocks.en: Case 1 - Deviation trend analysis: tiered management (Major → mandatory CAPA; Minor → trend tracking) + 12-month rolling window + Percentile 95 trigger mechanism. More than 2 events for the same destination/root cause → CAPA is triggered. CDMO application: include in the cold chain KPI analysis of the customer's APQR.

blocks.zh: 案例 2 — 被動保溫箱 SOP：六大要素缺一不可：組裝圖+照片、訓練記錄、隨機查核、運輸模式定義、PCM 調溫程序（含時間矩陣）、隔離材料說明。CDMO 應用：可直接作為通過 GDP 稽核的 SOP 設計模板。
blocks.en: Case 2 - Passive shipper SOP: all six elements are indispensable: assembly diagram + photos, training records, random audits, transport mode definition, PCM conditioning procedure (with time matrix), and separation material description. CDMO application: can be used directly as a template for an SOP design that passes GDP audits.

blocks.zh: 案例 3 — QMP 框架：DQ → OQ（靜態/熱腔室/冬夏兩季）→ Intermediate Report → PQ（動態/真實出貨/矩陣方法）→ 最終 QA 摘要報告。CDMO 應用：可作為向客戶交付的冷鏈資格認證總計畫標準格式。
blocks.en: Case 3 - QMP framework: DQ → OQ (static / thermal chamber / winter and summer seasons) → Intermediate Report → PQ (dynamic / real shipments / matrix approach) → final QA summary report. CDMO application: can serve as the standard format of the cold chain qualification master plan delivered to customers.

blocks.zh: 延伸閱讀優先級：PDA TR72（被動 TPS）、EU GDP Guidelines、USP <1079>、ISTA PCG-02、Van Asselt 七步驟白皮書——這五個文件構成冷鏈管理人員的核心知識基礎。
blocks.en: Priority of additional reading: PDA TR72 (passive TPS), EU GDP Guidelines, USP <1079>, ISTA PCG-02, and the Van Asselt seven-step white paper. These five documents form the core knowledge base for cold chain management staff.
